text: Domiati is unusual in that the milk is heavily salted before renneting, so only salt-tolerant bacteria can grow; the curd is then pickled in salted whey or brine, becoming more acid and sharply pickled in flavour with age.

links.name: El-Baradei et al., Appl. Environ. Microbiol. 73:1248 (2007)

steps.note: No starter, salt-tolerant lactic bacteria pickle the curd in salted whey or brine for up to 2–4 months, or it is eaten fresh.
